changelog:
Initial release of estimate-calories skill.

- Analyze food images to estimate calories and macro-nutrients (protein, carbs, fat, fiber) for each food item detected.
- Identify and name visible food items, estimate portion sizes in grams, and provide structured meal summaries.
- Includes guidelines for portion estimation, handling ambiguous foods, and factoring in hidden calories.
- Requests clarification from users if foods cannot be identified.
summary: Use this skill when estimating calories and macro-nutrients from food images
